scope.description: Mapped polygons associated through existing atlas map IDs entity-grenada in the 1920 boundary snapshot. This measures the displayed mapped extent, not an official contemporary statistic or all territory claimed by the polity.

evidence.locator: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/aourednik/historical-basemaps@master/geojson/world_1920.geojson; file SHA256 fce1c97dc6a6095594cbb7eb896ccd5ce8b2d72254e73a24148c0a4ea200849f; geometry SHA256 a2732249217b28262dff26fba284b2f83858c1035b6bc7c3e397cb38a737bb89; map IDs entity-grenada
evidence.note: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic polygon area, holes subtracted, exact duplicate/overlap union, antimeridian longitude unwrapping, three significant digits. No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 413.49268095272043 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. Derived from the actual boundary snapshot, not a population statistical geography.

qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.
Approximate historical polygons; three significant digits. Holes subtracted and overlapping mapped pieces counted once.
Boundary snapshot year is the geometry observation date. No continuous territorial validity is inferred between snapshots.
